fields.description:
Objective

Rebuild the Log Sign Up and Complete screen flows around the fields Reps actually fill in, organised into sections.

Implementation Requirements

* REMOVE First Bet Date and First Bet Amount from the Log Sign Up screen flow

* Include all Rep-editable fields, with values PRE-POPULATED from the record

* Section: Proof & Deposit Information (side-by-side layout matching the Lightning page where possible)

* Affiliate Signup Date

* Deposit Date

* Deposit Amount

* Sign up Proof (URL)

* Deposit Proof (URL)

* Wager Proof (URL)

* Section: Referral Information

* No Referrer checkbox — when checked, Referrer and Referral Type are hidden and NOT required

* Referrer

* Referral Type

* Secondary Referrer

Acceptance Criteria

* Flow opens with existing record values pre-populated

* Checking No Referrer hides and de-requires the referral fields

* First Bet fields no longer appear on the Log Sign Up screen

Dependencies

BUILD-14 (Secondary Referrer field — complete). No Referrer checkbox already added per build notes 2026-07-24.

Additional Notes

MERGED from two source items — both are edits to the same two flows.

Estimate: M · \~8h

Source: Wagertech Additional User Stories, July 2026 — items 29 and 42.

comments.body: Closing — Log/Complete flow rework delivered 2026-07-28 AM (Screen_Sign_Up_In_Progress v5, Screen_Sign_Up_Complete v6), tested and demoed to client same day. First Bet fields removed from Log flow; pre-population in place; No Referrer gating live.
